title: SAP security advisory – October 2026 monthly rollup (AV26-1030)
description: As of October 13, 2026, SAP_SE is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
SAP Commerce Cloud (OOTB Code)
	Version COM_CLOUD 2211-JDK21

SAP Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (Configuration Service)
	Version 15.5
Version XMII 15.4

SAP NetWeaver Visual Composer
	Version VC70RUNTIME 7.50

SAP NetWeaver and SAP Web Dispatcher (Internet Communication Manager)
	Versions HDB 2.00, KRNL64UC 7.53, WEBDISP 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, XS_ADVANCED_RUNTIME 1.00, SAP_EXTENDED_APP_SERVICES 1, CONTSERV 7.53, 7.54, KERNEL 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, 9.18, 9.19 and 9.20

Versions HDB 2.00, KRNL64UC 7.53, WEBDISP 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, XS_ADVANCED_RUNTIME 1.00, SAP_EXTENDED_APP_SERVICES 1, CONTSERV 7.53, 7.54, KERNEL 7.53, 7.54, 7.77, 7.93, 9.16, 9.18, 9.19 and 9.20

SAP S/4HANA (Manage Substitution/Validation Rules)
	Versions S4CORE 105, 106, 107, 108, 109
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
